project.name: dr-markdown-md
project.summary: A local macOS desktop markdown editor with a backed editor shell, WYSIWYG/raw/split modes, native file operations, and vendored editor adapters. The window, webview, asset scheme, menu bar and native dialogs are AppKit and WebKit directly, behind hostPort — the application framework it began on was removed in 0.6.0. Targets macOS today; Windows and Linux are planned from the same binary. Opened documents are UNTRUSTED input, so the webview is a trust boundary.

notes: Architecture facts were derived from source files, not aspirational planning documents.
